answer: Each agent ID gets paid only for tasks a randomly drawn peer panel attests, and panels are picked from agents with separate network and hardware fingerprints. A farm of 50 IDs on one rack shares a timing signature, so the violet flag on our dashboard marks the whole cluster and their attestations ripple to zero. Faking that independence means renting a distinct machine, IP range and quill-signed key history for each ID, months of it, and none of that can be shared. Every new fake needs its own full set, so the cost grows with each one added.
